body.statement: For a binary instrument, two well-defining exposure levels used in the causal contrast, and one merged potentially ill-defining exposure level, Gabriel, Sachs, and Sjolander Result 1 gives sharp bounds that are symbolically identical to the first eight lower and first eight upper expressions of their equations (3)--(4), namely the classical binary-instrument bounds.

attestation.note: Verified directly against the arXiv source text for Result 1 and the first eight lines of equations (3)--(4).

body.justification: This source fixes the correct published comparator when non-target categories are merged into one wholly untrusted remainder.
body.gap: The source handles one merged remainder, while the present proof shows why arbitrarily many untrusted categories reduce to that table.
body.consumer: The comparator-reductions proposition invokes Result 1 after constructing the merged table.
